verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair automation question for a bank-data API, and the evidence only glancingly touches it. A community user describes data refreshes as limited to daily pulls, and the docs list webhooks that fire when balance and transaction refreshes complete, which points to some recurring, product-managed data refresh. Missing for 10: any documented way for a user to define or schedule their own recurring jobs or workflows, control over cadence, and first-party docs describing scheduled refresh configuration.
